concepts.gloss_en: the OTHER/remaining languages of the nations (a subset excluding one, described as 'complete evil' / seventy stars)
the languages of the nations in general (the 'encompassing evil', רע הכולל)

notes: Different heads: שאר ('the rest/other') marks a subset excluding some singled-out language, and the proofs assign different roles — שאר לשונות העמים = רע גמור (seventy stars/complete evil), whereas plain לשונות העמים = רע הכולל (the encompassing/inclusive evil). Per rule 4 (a modifier changing the referent) and rule 1 (under-merge), kept separate.
